rationale: The momentum families on the board share the same fold history -- they all take the 2025-11 win and the 2026-07 loss together -- so stacking more momentum sleeves buys no genuine fold-complementarity. The only real fold-boundary diversification observed in the eq-flow analysis is at the momentum <-> low-beta carry boundary. This cell therefore pre-registers ONE momentum sleeve paired with the two genuine low-beta carry sleeves (the tradfi intraday open-impulse session sleeve and the state-VWAP dense-pair carry sleeve), so the M2 offline allocator measures a 3-family ERC blend rather than a momentum monoculture. Membership here is pre-registered; the weights are a data-PC measurement filled in after the sleeve return streams are materialized.
